metadata.division: DIVISION 6-1-1. PURPOSE; PUBLIC INTERESTS; FINDINGS; AND RELATIONSHIP TO OTHER REGULATIONS

content.title: 6-1-1-2. Public interests.
content.summary:
The City has a legitimate, important, substantial, or compelling interest in:
  1.	Preventing the proliferation of signs of generally increasing size, dimensions, and intrusiveness (also known as "sign clutter") that tends to result from property owners competing for the attention of passing motoris…
